title: COVID数据分析
problem_statement_md:
你正在处理加利福尼亚的COVID数据集，其中包括2020年每一天的病例数和死亡人数。
找到死亡/病例 比例最大的那一天。

要做到这一点，你需要首先计算死亡/病例比率，并作为一个新列添加到DataFrame中，命名为 **ratio**，然后找到与最大值相对应的行。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]COVID Data Analysis[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working with the COVID dataset for California, which includes the number of cases and deaths for each day of 2020.
Find the day when the deaths/cases ratio was largest.

To do this, you need to first calculate the deaths/cases ratio and add it as a column to the DataFrame with the name '[b]ratio[/b]', then find the row that corresponds to the largest value.
[note][b]Important[/b]: The output should be a [b]DataFrame[/b], containing all of the columns of the dataset for the corresponding row.[/note]
hint_md: 输出应该是一个**DataFrame**，包含相应行的数据集的所有列。

code_templates.solution_code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

df['ratio'] = df["deaths"] / df["cases"]
max_ratio = max(df["ratio"])

print(df[df["ratio"]==max_ratio])
